title: CRLA/151/2003 of RAJ PAL Vs STATE

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT
NAINITAL
Criminal Appeal No.151 of 2003
Raj Pal
 Ö Appellant
Versus
State of Uttaranchal (now Uttarakhand)
 Ö Respondent
Sri S.K. Mandal, Advocate for the appellant.
Sri R.K. Shah, Dy. Adv. General (Criminal) for the State.
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
 Appellant Raj Pal has been convicted by the
learned Additional Sessions Judge, Udham Singh
Nagar (Rudrapur) in Special Sessions Trial No.148 of
2000, for the offence of Section 18 of the Narcotics
Drugs & Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
(hereinafter to be referred as ëthe Actí). He was
sentenced to three yearsí rigorous imprisonment, in
addition to fine of Rs.2,000/-, in default of which, three
monthsí additional simple imprisonment was awarded.
 Learned counsel for the appellant, instead of
arguing the appeal on merits, prays for the clemency of
this Court for the reason that only 8 kilograms of
opium straw (DODA) was allegedly recovered from the
possession of the appellant. Learned counsel apprised
the Court that the appellant remained in jail eversince
his date of arrest w.e.f. 5.8.2000 to 14.11.2000 i.e. for
three months and ten days. Further, after his
conviction by the trial court, he was kept in prison
w.e.f. 16.5.2003 to 25.5.2003, i.e. for further ten days.
This has also been got verified from the record.

2
 Learned counsel further argued that the
appellant is a very poor person, leading a very difficult
life in penury. He further submitted that the entire
family of the accused will be ruined if he is sent to jail
again.
 Looking to the period of detention as well as
the quantity of opium straw (DODA), recovered from his
possession, the Court hereby maintains the conviction
of appellant but reduces the sentence to the period
already undergone by him. It is hereby made clear that
fine of Rs.2,000/- imposed by the trial court is left
intact. In case the fine has not been paid, the same
will be deposited by him within a period of one month
from today. In case of failure, appellant will suffer
three monthsí simple imprisonment.
 The appeal is disposed of in the above terms.
 Let the recovered contraband goods be
destroyed as per rules.
 It is hereby made clear that the facts and
circumstances of each case are to be considered
separately and the judgment of this case will not be
treated as a precedent for any other case.
 A copy of this judgment and order along with
the lower court record be transmitted to the court
concerned for compliance.
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.)
09.04.2014
Rdang
